source_caption_data.pre_caption: This video presents a static, extreme wide shot of a landscape. A massive storm cloud dominates the composition, occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame and stretching across its entire width from the middle ground to the background. Below this, a flat green prairie fills the bottom third of the frame, extending from the foreground to the horizon in the background. A wire fence runs horizontally across the immediate foreground at the very bottom of the frame. A bolt of lightning strikes vertically near the center of the frame, connecting the base of the cloud in the middle ground to the distant background, where a small town is silhouetted on the horizon. The camera is positioned at a low height, level with the field, looking across the landscape and slightly up toward the vast cloud formation.
